checklist.evidence: Pre-review and ordinary commit binding now compare the retained Runner snapshot, result-artifact digest, all required result fields, and log digest. However, an untouched successful execution returned COMPLETE and its immediate status call failed because _bind_verification_artifact no longer writes task_id/base_commit/candidate_id while terminal validation still requires them. A commit-interruption probe then changed test JSON command plus the Sol review verification contract; resume accepted the correlated tampering, committed three tasks, and returned COMPLETE. Only a later status call blocked.

Generic and arbitrary evidence rejection, code-specific identifiers, current identity fields, immutable request-change binding, and non-colliding review numbering are present. However, terminal validation checks only state.replan_reason_ref. In an independent two-replan run, replan_reason_1.json referenced sol_review_1.json and replan_reason_2.json referenced sol_review_3.json. After removing the unrelated FINAL-F005 schema mismatch from the probe, status returned COMPLETE both before and after sol_review_1.json was modified, proving earlier accepted strategic evidence is not durably revalidated.

Independent full suite: 158 passed and 53 subtests passed in 313.81s. HEAD/tree, staged diff SHA-256, repair delta SHA-256 48067f157415e1bedb93a1088d4510447e4a5ce0942b280cdc937fdf6e307058 with length 28391, all five staged checksum entries, git diff --cached --check, and absence of staged bytecode paths were independently verified.

blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 7, 8 and 11; Milestone 3 T5-T6; FINAL-F005 verification contract
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Runner sequence, pass state, return code, normalized command, result-artifact hash, log reference, and log hash must remain independently bound before Sol approval and Hermes commit across execute, resume, reconciliation, and terminal paths; Sol must copy the complete contract exactly.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: _reconcile_pending_commit reconstructs the verification contract solely from mutable test JSON and compares it with the mutable review, without invoking _bind_verification_artifact against state.test_results or checking the recorded review digest. Correlated test/review tampering was therefore committed on resume. Separately, valid terminal status fails because test artifacts no longer receive identity fields still required at lines 7278-7280.
blocking_findings.observed_state: Ordinary pre-review binding rejects isolated command, sequence, or log tampering, but commit reconciliation can accept correlated artifact/review mutation. Fresh execute returns COMPLETE without terminal validation, and an untampered subsequent status blocks on the internal artifact-schema mismatch.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Every commit and reconciliation path must compare immutable Runner and review identities retained independently of their mutable artifacts. Valid terminal evidence must pass, all terminal-return paths must revalidate before returning, and any isolated or correlated provenance mutation must block before commit.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: Hermes can commit a candidate using post-approval fabricated verification provenance, while valid completed runs are not reliably resumable or inspectable.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Call the independent Runner binder during pending-commit reconciliation, verify the recorded review digest before trusting approval, align terminal validation with the actual immutable verification schema, and validate before every COMPLETE return. Add valid-terminal controls plus correlated result/review tampering probes for execute, resume, reconciliation, and status.

blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 5, 6, 8 and 11; Milestone 2 T4 and Milestone 3 T6; previous FINAL-F007 required correction
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Every accepted non-user replan must retain immutable, code-specific, identity-bound evidence whose recorded digest remains verifiable through execute, resume, and terminal status; later replans must not make earlier accepted evidence unverifiable or unchecked.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: _validate_terminal_state validates only the single current replan_reason_ref. It neither enumerates nor validates earlier replan_reason_*.json history. A two-replan probe completed with reason refs for sol_review_1.json and sol_review_3.json; modifying the first accepted Sol artifact afterward was not detected by status.
blocking_findings.observed_state: The latest replan reason is hash-checked and code-specific, and artifact-name reuse is prevented, but prior accepted reasons become orphaned from runtime validation once replan_reason_ref advances.
blocking_findings.expected_state: All durable replan reasons must form a complete non-colliding history whose recorded artifacts and hashes are revalidated against their contemporaneous plan/request/task/base/candidate/verification identities on execute, resume, and status.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: A strategic Astra invocation can remain part of run history after its authoritative evidence is altered or lost, while the run still reports COMPLETE.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Derive or persist the complete ordered replan history and validate every reason and referenced artifact, including historical identity snapshots, before planning continuation or terminal acceptance. Add two-replan tests that tamper the earlier reason, Sol review, candidate, verification, and request artifact and assert blocking without additional Astra or Luna calls.

next_actions: Repair FINAL-F005 reconciliation and terminal-schema binding, then run isolated and correlated execute/resume/status tamper probes.
Repair FINAL-F007 by revalidating the complete immutable replan history, then test stale earlier evidence across execute, resume, and status.
